prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page composition, 1440x900 landscape first viewport for ResearchAI.
Primary request: Design a colorful, art-directed, practical WEBSITE first viewport for an AI research product, where the LIVE RESEARCH PROCESS unfolds as an EDITORIAL FILMSTRIP. The page should feel like a digital art piece built from real research stages, not a marketing template, static poster, photograph, or generic dashboard. Vertical scrolling will advance through a sequence of large typographic frames; the first viewport shows the opening frame dominant and glimpses of the next stage frames to invite scrolling.
Structure: small clean top nav, ResearchAI. at left and Sign in at right. Under it, prominent but elegant two-tab switch 'Normal' (active) and 'Deep research'. Hero headline in dramatic Playfair-like serif: 'Every answer has a story.' Supporting line: 'Follow a question from search to sourced report.' Bright yellow rectangular 'Start researching' button. Clearly label 'ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE'. The sample question 'How can cities stay cooler?' should be part of a large first frame, with a compact realistic search/source excerpt. Along the lower or right edge, show a filmstrip-like sequence of next chapter previews numbered 01 'Search the web', 02 'Read the sources', 03 'Write the report', 04 'Review & refine'. The active frame should be the largest; partial next frames show scroll progression. Source references are simple generic 'Source 01' and 'Source 02', not named publishers.
Visual world: retain the existing ResearchAI elegant editorial typography and report-reading character, white paper canvas, black ink, rectangular controls, hairline rules, vivid yellow research action, violet/purple accents, teal highlight, with blue/red/green pipeline accents. Use daring shifts in color blocks across filmstrip frames, intentional crop, large type, and restrained source-paper fragments. This is expressive, warm, tactile and clearly interactive. Strong first-viewport hierarchy and readable UI; no invented metrics, fake scientific claims, testimonials, prices, news brands, publication logos, stock people, robots, AI galaxies, glassmorphism, or gradient fog.
Include a small visible scroll cue 'Scroll to follow the research'. Keep all requested words legible and do not add unrelated site navigation.
